column1: # This is a correction of parity-question-set.tsv per the adversarial audit
# Same 52 ids, same format. 30 rows unchanged (SOUND). 15 rows changed:
# 9 CONTRIVED rows reworded to remove verbatim/near-verbatim leakage from the
# target file's own text (c01,c04,c06,c08,c12,c17,d03,k03,k04 — k04 also had
# its query's premise corrected, not just its wording), and 6 INCOMPLETE-ACCEPT
# rows had padding removed and/or missing legitimate accept files added
# (d01,d02,d09,g02,k01,s08). Full per-row rationale and verification quotes:
# fusion.rs-dependent rows (c06,s02,s03,s07) are flagged VOLATILE in the
# methods note — same wave's own +480/-36 rerank work touches this file —
# but are kept, since removing them would only shrink coverage further.
#   category  code | symbol | doctrine | config | knowledge | memory
#   query     asked the way a developer would ask it, NOT lifted from the
#             target file's own wording (that would measure lexical echo)
#   accept    comma-separated `<source>:<relative-path>`; more than one only
#             where two paths are genuinely the same answer (a symlink, a
#             file mirrored under two declared sources, or the owning
#             document plus the context file that quotes it) OR where two
#             distinct real files answer the query equally well.
# whose answers live in this repository and can therefore be scanned in CI.
# The knowledge-library / agent-memory / sergeant-rs-workspace rows are the
# estate-wide half of the same set and are measured out of tree; they are
# committed here because a question set split across two files stops being
# verified against sergeant-rs:af3ec4675 (prose lane) and the workspace repo
